referenceSources.description:
This photograph captures the rear of a dark gray 1989 Volkswagen Golf G60 Limited, showcasing its distinctive dual exhaust outlets, BBS RM wheels, and Volkswagen Motorsport badge. The hatchback’s clean lines and subtle blue grille trim hint at the powerful supercharged 16-valve engine hidden beneath the hood.

One of only 71 units produced, this number 16 example has traveled 108,900 kilometers and remains in excellent condition, with original paint and interior. The Syncro all-wheel-drive system and 207 hp output made it a standout performer in its era, accelerating from 0 to 100 km/h in just over six seconds.
